title: JavaScript: Timing Functions
description: Write a JavaScript program using setTimeout and setInterval for timed execution.
verificationTest: output.includes('Start') && output.includes('After scheduling timeout') && output.includes('Tick 1') && output.includes('Tick 3')
hints: `setTimeout(callback, delay)` runs a callback once after delay ms
Use `clearTimeout()` and `clearInterval()` to cancel pending timers

steps.title: setTimeout basics
steps.description: Use setTimeout to print "Hello after 2 seconds" after a 2000ms delay.

steps.title: setInterval counter
steps.description: Use setInterval to print a counter every second, stopping after 5 times with clearInterval.
